high_level_description: This image captures a scene at the Apukka Resort, as indicated by the large sign on the structure. The sign reads "APUKKA RESORT" with decorative patterns on either side of the text. Below the sign, there is a large thermometer mounted on the same structure, showing temperatures ranging from -45°C to 30°C. In the foreground, a person with long, wavy brown hair is seen from behind, wearing a blue jacket. They appear to be taking a photo or video of the thermometer using a smartphone held in their right hand. The person's posture suggests they are engaged in capturing the moment.
